fields.why: Table 2 reports group-specific aORs for race/ethnicity, income, metro status, sex and age, so these are stratifiers. A records race and rurality only as covariates, yet its own level-2 reading rests on those aORs. A's extra covariate roles for age, sex and rurality, as weighting variables, are defensible additions.

brief_issues: The brief does not say which role to give an SPD that is both a weighting variable and a model term with reported per-level aORs; recording both covariate and stratifier would settle it.
